verdict.rationale: kitty's own docs say it can be extended with kittens written in Python. The hands-on probe confirms it can be driven from external scripts via `kitten @` remote control, and a docs heading points to customizing a kitten's matching and actions. The Python-extension claim is only a one-line mention, though, with no evidence of how custom kittens are written or what APIs they get. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on writing custom kittens (APIs, loading, lifecycle), hands-on or independent corroboration of a user-written Python kitten, evidence of plugin reach beyond kittens and remote-control scripting.
